question: An onsite round for a Senior Software Engineer role (7 years of experience) at Salesforce combining one DSA question with a low-level design of the Connect 4 game (a 6-row by 7-column grid where two players drop discs into columns and the first to connect four in a row, column or diagonal wins).
lookingFor: Can you identify the entities and give them clear responsibilities (Board, Player, Game, Disc)?
Is the win-check logic efficient and correct in all four directions?
Does the design handle invalid moves, a full column, a draw and turn order?
Is it extensible (board size, win length, more players, undo) without over-engineering?
Do you consider testability and, if asked, concurrency?
followUps: How would you make the win condition and board size configurable?
How would you implement undo and replay?
How would you add a computer opponent?
How would you extend this for an online multiplayer game?
Why check only around the last move?
